requirements.description: User registration and secure authentication.
requirements.evidence: Registration, login/logout, server-side sessions, scrypt password hashes, CSRF protection on mutations and throttled failed-login attempts are implemented.
requirements.test: Operations API auth tests and final 48-test regression suite passed; Edge admin/manager login and logout passed.
requirements.action: Configure a managed session secret, TLS and secure cookies for any production deployment.

requirements.description: Role-based permissions.
requirements.evidence: Administrator, regional manager, restaurant manager and analyst roles are enforced server-side; location scope and CSRF are checked for mutations.
requirements.test: Analyst mutation denial, manager location-scope denial and browser HTTP 403 checks passed.
requirements.action: Reassess role permissions when additional operational workflows are introduced.

requirements.description: Administrator can create and maintain restaurant locations.
requirements.evidence: Operational SQLite location records support authorized list/create/read/update/delete workflows without changing canonical analytics.
requirements.test: Admin CRUD and manager-scope API tests passed; Edge verified operational location persistence.
requirements.action: Retain the operational/analytical data boundary.

requirements.description: Menu management for categories, items, prices, costs, descriptions and availability.
requirements.evidence: Operational CRUD stores menu categories and items with description, availability, price and cost fields; price edits create history rows.
requirements.test: Menu/category CRUD, price-history API assertions and Edge management workflow passed.
requirements.action: Keep operational edits isolated from canonical Spark v4 outputs.

requirements.description: Maintain menu-item pricing history.
requirements.evidence: Menu creation and price updates append effective-time pricing history with actor and reason in SQLite.
requirements.test: Price changes produced initial and update history rows with old/new values; browser verified initial history.
requirements.action: Keep history append-only and review any future correction workflow.

requirements.description: Maintain anonymized customer profiles and behavior.
requirements.evidence: Operational customer creation generates an application-issued anon_ key and rejects direct personal identifiers in behavior profiles.
requirements.test: Privacy regression verifies generated anonymized ID and rejects an email-bearing profile; final 48-test regression suite passed.
requirements.action: Review privacy controls and retention before any production use.

requirements.description: Store order headers and detailed order-line transactions.
requirements.evidence: Operational SQLite stores order headers and order lines with linked customer, location, promotion and menu-item constraints.
requirements.test: Manager order creation passed and cross-location order mutation was denied.
requirements.action: Continue enforcing the configured foreign-key and location-scope rules.

requirements.description: Maintain promotions, discounts, coupons, campaigns and applicable items.
requirements.evidence: Operational promotion records support date ranges, discount percentages, active state and applicable menu items; distinct coupon codes/redemption tracking are not modeled.
requirements.test: Generic operational CRUD, relational constraints and the full suite passed; promotion-specific coupon/redemption scenarios remain untested.
requirements.action: Add coupon identifiers, redemption rules and dedicated promotion CRUD tests if required.

requirements.description: Store ratings linked to items or restaurants.
requirements.evidence: Operational ratings persist customer, restaurant, optional menu item, score and timestamp with relational constraints.
requirements.test: Rating entity is included in the validated operational CRUD registry; final application suite passed.
requirements.action: Add rating-specific edge-case tests for future workflow changes.

requirements.description: Maintain inventory use, stock, replenishment and consumption.
requirements.evidence: Operational inventory CRUD persists on-hand, consumed, replenishment and reorder quantities with nonnegative constraints.
requirements.test: Inventory fields and validation are registered in operational CRUD; final application suite passed.
requirements.action: Add inventory-specific consumption and replenishment workflow tests.

requirements.description: Maintain wastage with quantity, cost, item, location, date and reason.
requirements.evidence: Operational wastage CRUD persists quantity, cost, item, location, date and reason under nonnegative and foreign-key constraints.
requirements.test: Wastage entity fields and validation are registered in operational CRUD; final application suite passed.
requirements.action: Add wastage-specific edge-case tests and keep records separate from canonical analytics.

requirements.description: Use Spark/PySpark to ingest large restaurant datasets.

requirements.test: V4 full ingestion execution evidence; live HDFS-backed app health succeeds.

requirements.description: Calculate revenue, cost, contribution margin and profitability.
requirements.evidence: Menu net revenue allocates order-level discounts proportionally across item lines; cost, contribution margin, margin percent and wastage proxy calculated for 200 items. Independent pandas values for units/orders/gross/net revenue/cost/margin agree within 0.01 on all 200 items. It omits repeat rate, rating-linked attribution, promotion dependency and sales trend; costs use static menu cost.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Complete omitted SRS dimensions and validate static cost semantics.

requirements.description: Classify every menu item into defined performance groups.
requirements.evidence: All 200 items receive SRS classes when sufficient data exist; p75 sales/margin/waste-ratio thresholds are data-derived. New (<90 day) launches and invalid cost are explicit exceptions. Tricky-case tests cover high-pop/low-margin, low-pop/high-margin, high-waste, zero-sales, missing cost and new items.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.

requirements.description: Segment customers by behavioral patterns.

requirements.evidence: Per-purchasing-customer recency, distinct completed-order frequency, monetary value, average order value and restaurant diversity are saved. Source customers with no completed orders are omitted.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.

requirements.description: Discover frequently purchased menu combinations.
requirements.evidence: Distinct-item baskets for completed orders yield 955 retained item-pair rows from 611,135 baskets using minimum count 100.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Consider larger itemsets only if operationally useful.

requirements.description: Calculate support, confidence and lift.
requirements.evidence: Support, both-direction confidence and lift are calculated from keyed completed-order baskets; minimum pair count 100 and confidence threshold 0.10 are recorded.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Thresholds are discovery cutoffs, not statistical significance tests.

requirements.description: Recommend bundle/cross-sell products from associations.
requirements.evidence: Verified directional basket recommendations are generated from observed association rules, retained at confidence >=0.10 and lift >1.0, and served with antecedent-to-consequent wording and direction-specific confidence. They are deterministic candidates, not causal claims.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Keep candidate wording noncausal and monitor recommendation acceptance before claiming business impact.

requirements.description: Predict future demand.
requirements.evidence: Future demand is predicted at restaurant-hour scope and frozen item/category/location daily scopes.
requirements.test: Live/reconciled production forecasting remains future work.
requirements.action: Maintain evidence if the model/data snapshot changes.

requirements.description: Evaluate forecasts with suitable metrics.
requirements.evidence: Freshly scored the saved Spark/Python models and seasonal-naive baseline on the identical 55,200-row held-out June-August period; a separate 500-case report records evenly spaced keyed predictions. Spark uses Sunday=0 and the saved Python model uses Monday=0, so cross-model case differences remain descriptive, not feature-equivalent.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Retain the weekday encoding caveat; align semantics only through a separately trained and validated model.

requirements.description: Analyze food wastage trends.
requirements.evidence: Wastage quantity/cost is grouped by restaurant, item/category, month, weekday and reason. Demand, inventory, promotion, preparation quantity and exposure-normalized rates are not all integrated.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Add remaining aligned operational dimensions and denominators.

requirements.description: Predict high-risk wastage items/periods.
requirements.evidence: A weekly future wastage-cost risk classifier is trained and tested on a chronological panel. Target is next-week item/location cost >= training-only positive-week p75 (1,596.2); prediction is at target-week start from lagged waste/demand and known calendar/category/location. Three Spark ML models compared on validation, logistic regression selected by PR-AUC then validation F1; test is isolated. Test PR-AUC 0.0906 vs prevalence/majority baseline PR-AUC 0.0587, recall 0.5467, precision 0.0907, F1 0.1556; persistence/reload inference 16/16 passed. This is low-precision risk triage, not causal attribution.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Treat as a screening signal only; improve precision/utility and broaden cost drivers before operational use.

requirements.description: Analyze demand changes following price changes and classify price sensitivity.
requirements.evidence: Observed before/after 30-day item/location unit response and sensitivity bands are calculated for 2,992 price-change records. The association is not controlled or causal.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Account for zeros, concurrent promotions, exposure duration, and confounding; validate sensitivity classification.

requirements.description: Evaluate promotions by revenue, profit, customer behavior and wastage.
requirements.evidence: Promotion orders have revenue, order/customer counts, AOV and estimated contribution margin. Customer acquisition/repeat cohorts, wastage and post-promotion outcomes are absent.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
requirements.action: Add acquisition/repeat/post-period and wastage measures with noncausal wording.

requirements.description: Detect promotion traps where sales rise but profitability or other KPIs fall.
requirements.evidence: A simple trap signal compares promotional cohorts with overall non-promotion averages for AOV and estimated per-order margin; no promotion met this rule in this dataset. This is uncontrolled.
requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.

requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.

requirements.test: Full regression: 48 passed; security API suite: 8 passed; live Edge/CDP browser verification: all routes and checks passed. See results/regression_full.log, results/audit/security_verification.log, and results/app/browser_verification.json.
